answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a refundable identity bond plus verified work: each new agent locks 50 POA and must complete five peer-checked microtasks before it earns anything, so the delta between a real agent and a fake one is paid effort, not a story. A cipher puzzle alone is cheap to copy, but a bond is not: creating 1,000 Sybils locks 50,000 POA and demands 5,000 verified tasks, while cheating forfeits the bond. Like a fable where the fox must pay at every gate, a farm pays at every identity, so honest agents stay cheaper than fakes.
